item.title: Carolina Hurricanes' Pyotr Kochetkov Out For Season
item.description: The Carolina Hurricanes will have to rely on their goaltending depth as goaltender Pyotr Kochetkov is undergoing surgery and is expected to be out for the season.The 26-year-old Russian netminder has appeared in just nine games this season, posting a 6-2-0 record, with a 2.33 goals against average and .899 save percentage. item.description: It looks like we'll soon be able to scratch another center off the ranks of unrestricted free agents next summer. item.title: Calgary Flames Lock Up Devin Cooley With Multi-Year Extension
item.description: Devin Cooley has made quite the impression as backup goalie for the Calgary Flames—both on and off the ice. In 13 appearances (10 starts), he's logged a .914 save percentage and a 2.40 goals against average. It appears @GoldenKnights William Karlsson will not be available for the Olympics.
